summary: PDF reader paints the text selection itself, one light box per line behind the text (as Zotero does), instead of the browser's per-span highlight that overlapped into dark misaligned stripes; the paper-detail backdrop no longer inherits the global pill button shape.

budget_impact.rationale: Presentation only: CSS and a local DOM painter. No model call, network or stored data change.
budget_impact.before: native per-span selection highlight; pill-shaped detail backdrop
budget_impact.after: one painted box per selected line; plain full-screen backdrop

open_risks: Checked in Chromium, not in WebKit (the macOS app engine).
Not tested on real papers with ligatures, rotated or right-to-left text.
